title: SEBI revises closing auction and F&O rules

timeline.title: SEBI revises closing auction and F&O rules
timeline.line: SEBI changed closing-auction timings and derivative settlement prices, in two phases
more: Review covers the closing auction session (CAS) and its timings
Also changes how settlement prices of derivative contracts are set
The changes will be rolled out in two phases
